description: A set of natural numbers is computably enumerable exactly when it is the range of a unary partial recursive function, allowing the empty range.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.enumerable_iff_partial_range (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ ∃ f, Nat.Partrec f ∧ ∀ (y : ℕ), A y ↔ ∃ x, y ∈ f x
